Multiple sclerosis. In a small open-label study, 5 out of 7 pa- tients with multiple sclerosis (p.892) benefited from mycopheno- late mofetil; 3 of these patients reported improved movement.1 A retrospective review2 of mycophenolate mofetil treatment (given either adjunctively or as monotherapy) in 79 patients, reported subjective improvements in 12 patients given adjunctive therapy. 1.
